conversion_events.visit: first-party consent-compliant qualified-human session keyed to actual asset_id, where observable
conversion_events.cta: offer-guide click separate from checkout or lead
conversion_events.affiliate_click: outbound click only, NEVER paid order
conversion_events.confirmed_lead: Jetpack/provider-confirmed consent and delivery, not form submit
conversion_events.paid_order: verified merchant purchase ref; not assumed
conversion_events.commission: merchant/affiliate provider reported settlement with currency/time, not assumed
conversion_events.net_revenue: reconciled cleared orders/commissions less non-duplicated fees, refunds, variable costs
conversion_events.main_kpi: 1000 * realized_net_revenue / qualified_human_sessions (7 and 30 day, null when data missing)
conversion_events.no_personal_data: no email/IP/UA fingerprint/customer identity/subID values in public logs; use aggregate counts and permissioned joins

alternatives.other_public_paid: Legacy Triage Payhip listing is preparedness/estate domain, not an appropriate Mind offer; no cross-lane commercialization
alternatives.default_no_authorized_merchant: Leave CTA disabled and preserve the free alternative.
